original_source_description: Fallback: Woods B et al. Value in Health 2016;19(8):929-935 methodology scaled to Australia health expenditure per capita. No published Australian opportunity-cost threshold; PBAC applies AUD 45,000-75,000/QALY in practice. Conservative midpoint AUD 50,000 x 0.655 = USD 32,750.
PBAC informal threshold ~AUD 75,000/QALY upper end. AUD 75,000 x 0.655 = USD 49,125.
1x GDP per capita 2024, IMF WEO

Ochalek J et al. BMJ Global Health 2018;3:e000964. Brazil (upper-middle income): opportunity cost threshold ~0.3-0.4x GDP per capita. 0.35 x USD 10,282 = USD 3,599. Wide prior (2x). Cross-reference: Pichon-Riviere A et al. Lancet Glob Health 2023 - Brazil.
1x GDP per capita 2024, World Bank/IMF
CONITEC 2022 final recommendations: BRL 40,000 per QALY in 2022; annual update by GDP per capita.

Ochalek J et al. Estimating health opportunity costs in low-income and middle-income countries. BMJ Global Health 2018;3(6):e000964. For upper-middle income countries, opportunity cost threshold estimated below 1x GDP per capita; ~0.3-0.5x GDP. Using 0.35x: 0.35 x USD 13,441 = USD 4,704. Wide prior (2x factor for structural uncertainty).
1x GDP per capita 2024, IMF WEO
NICE technology appraisal threshold GBP 20,000-30,000/QALY. Midpoint GBP 25,000 (2024) x 1.267 GBP/USD = USD 31,675.

Woods B et al. Country-Level Cost-Effectiveness Thresholds. Value in Health 2016;19(8):929-935. England NHS opportunity cost ~GBP 13,000/QALY (Claxton et al. 2015); inflated to 2024: GBP 13,000 x 1.27 x 1.267 = USD 20,900.
